###Chapter 1
The Vanderbilt House was buzzing with excitement. The James family was throwing a huge party for Claire's coming-of-age celebration.
Everyone knew Latham and Octavia's daughter. Claire was stunning, smart, and talented, the kind of girl everyone admired.
As guests gathered around to compliment Claire, Lance showed up, leading in a girl who looked about Claire's age.
"Mom, Dad, Claire isn't your real daughter. She's just pretending to be!" Lance announced, his voice cutting through the chatter. "Cindy is the real daughter of the James family."
He nudged Cindy forward. The moment everyone saw her face, the resemblance to Octavia was obvious.
A shockwave swept through the room. People gasped. Latham and Octavia stared, speechless.
Latham tried to brush it off, thinking Lance was joking, but then Lance pulled out two DNA reports.
He handed them over. "One's Claire's. It says she's not related to you or Mom. The other one is Cindy's. I could only test her with Mom since Dad was away, but it proves Cindy is your real daughter."
Latham read the results. His face turned pale. “How could Claire not be my child? Who switched my baby?"
Octavia clutched the papers, her hands shaking, and then she fainted. Latham scooped her up and hurried out, not looking back.
Lance didn't follow. He turned to Claire, eyes cold. "Well? Don't just stand there. Go pack your things."
Claire hadn't said a single word. She just nodded and followed Lance home, Cindy trailing behind.
The guests looked at each other, whispering, eager to gossip about what they'd just
seen.
